volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Low. Default −1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out High. Default +1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Low. Default 0. Slider domain −10…+10.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In High. Default +1. Slider domain −10…+10.

model.tooltip: for Lin Amp = current sandbox ping (fb x0.7718, 0-1000 Hz, amp on inertial target). for Exp Amp = soundemote.io / old pluck3 (0-10 Hz, amp on output). Default for Lin Amp (key Long, choiceId 1).

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: On = latch Attack/Decay/Amplitude on rising Trigger. Off = knobs always live. Rising Trigger never resets the envelope level.

attack.tooltip: One-pole rise toward Trigger/Gate from the current level (no snap-reset). 0 = instant.

decay.tooltip: for Lin model: 0 = short fall, 1 = long (x=clamp(env+(0.5−Decay))→0…10 Hz). for Exp model: 0 = offset 1, 1 = offset 0 (env×0.7718+(1−Decay)→0…1000 Hz).

amplitude.tooltip: for Lin model: scales output (env×amp). for Exp model: scales Trigger into inertial target.

decayTime.tooltip: Seconds from the Trigger hit to zero. env = height * amplitude * pow(1 - t / decayTime, power).

power.tooltip: Curve exponent. 1 = linear. Higher = sharper drop and longer flat tail. 0 = hold, then cut at Decay Time.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Out = Trigger height * Amplitude * curve.

updateOnTrigger.tooltip: On: Attack/Release/curves/Amplitude latch on Gate rise. Off: params apply live.

inputMode.tooltip: Gate = follow high/low (hold at peak while gated). Trigger = rising edge fires one Attack→Release.

attackShape.tooltip: Bipolar segment shape. 0 = linear, + = exponential (fast→slow), − = logarithmic (slow→fast).

release.tooltip: Fall time from current level → 0. 0 = instant snap.

releaseShape.tooltip: Bipolar shape for release. 0 = linear, + = exp, − = log.

highFreq.tooltip: Sweep start frequency (the click). Latched on each Trigger. Clamped to 50 Hz ... half the sample rate.

lowFreq.tooltip: Frequency the sweep settles toward (a tuned body). 0 = keeps falling. Latched on each Trigger.

sweepTime.tooltip: Time to fall from High Freq to Low Freq + 50 Hz. Latched on each Trigger. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

chirp.tooltip: Tail power of the sweep. + holds the highs longer, then drops fast. - drops fast at first, then lingers low. Acts at once. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

chirpShape.tooltip: Attack knee vs decay at the same tail power. + keeps the start frequency a little longer, - rounds the knee. Acts at once. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

wave.tooltip: Waveform family. Sine. TriSaw = triangle that morphs to saws with Wave Shape. SinFatSaw = sine-shaped TriSaw (bulging fat saws). From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

waveShape.tooltip: Saw-down (-1) ... symmetric (0) ... saw-up (+1). No effect on Sine. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

phase.tooltip: Start phase offset. Trigger hard-resets the oscillator to this phase. 0 = clean start at zero. +-0.25 = starts at a peak: hard click.

decay.tooltip: Amplitude envelope: seconds to fall 60 dB (T60) after a hit. Drives Env and the Kick level. Acts at once.

amplitude.tooltip: Kick output level. Does not scale Env.

decayTime.tooltip: When the slow exp e^{−x} hits −60 dB (0.001). Mix p blends in a faster exp.

mix.tooltip: (1−p)·e^{−x} + p·e^{−rate·x}. 0 = slow exp only. 1 = fast exp only.

rate.tooltip: How many times faster the second exponential is. 1 = same as the slow term.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Out = mix-curve(Trigger height) × Amplitude.

decayTime.tooltip: Seconds from Trigger height to 0.001 (hyperbolic amp-shape).

shape.tooltip: Exp time warp on the hyperbolic curve. 0 = linear time.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Out = hyperbolic(Trigger height → 0.001) × Amplitude.

decayTime.tooltip: Seconds from Trigger to 0.001. Shape w = 0 is a straight line height → 0.001.

shape.tooltip: Exp time warp (Marvinh). 0 = linear time. Positive = slow start then drop. Negative = fast start then long tail.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Out = curve(Trigger height) × Amplitude.

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

duty.tooltip: Gate high time as a fraction of the period. Quantized to whole samples at the current rate.

method.tooltip: Sine SSOT default = Wavetable (additive half-sine LUT 2¹⁵). Polynomial = joint quadrant poly. std::sin = full-range sandbox poly (freestanding; no libm). Taylor = short quadrant-folded Taylor (continuous at wrap).

phase.tooltip: Phase offset (cycles). Knob + Phase MOD from audio-rate sources add sample-accurately.

freq.tooltip: Hz. Parameter MOD is domain-add (base + CV). Set base 0 and wire Pitch Detector / Knob Bias for absolute Hz. Enable Bipolar in param settings for thru-zero FM (negative Hz = reverse phase).

updateOnTrigger.tooltip: On: Attack/Release/curves/Amplitude latch on Gate rise. Off: params apply live.

inputMode.tooltip: Gate = follow high/low (hold at peak while gated). Trigger = rising edge fires one Attack→Release.

attackShape.tooltip: Bipolar segment shape. 0 = linear, + = exponential (fast→slow), − = logarithmic (slow→fast).

release.tooltip: Fall time from current level → 0. 0 = instant snap.

releaseShape.tooltip: Bipolar shape for release. 0 = linear, + = exp, − = log.

drive.tooltip: Input push into the soft-knee curve.

threshold.tooltip: Amplitude (0...1) where limiting starts. Below this the driven signal is unchanged.

knee.tooltip: How gradual the transition from Threshold toward full scale is. 0 = hard at Threshold.

shape.tooltip: Analog = one-pole (exp decay tail). Linear / Smoothstep / Log = finite time. Log = log attack (fast then ease) and log decay/release (finishes the drop, no floor taper).

attack.tooltip: Attack time. Modulatable. Gate↑ attacks from current level (no hard restart).

decay.tooltip: Decay time to Sustain × velocity. Modulatable.

sustain.tooltip: Sustain level (0…1), scaled by Gate velocity. Modulatable.

release.tooltip: Release time after Gate falls. Modulatable.
